claims.marina: The Marina Resort stands on the river below the National Museum and includes the slave museum.
claims.dukeTown: Duke Town church on Eyamba Street was built in 1846 and is one of the oldest churches in Nigeria.
claims.tinapa: Tinapa Resort is on the north-west side of Calabar.
claims.obudu: Obudu Mountain Resort is a few hours' drive from Calabar.
